d1.medium: Hand-set SVG on a 16-column 8px grid; every shape snaps to integer grid units
d1.motion: Hard cuts and kinetic type: 0ms state swaps, type slides on steps of 8px, Carbon productive cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.38,0.9) 110ms
d1.accents: Square buttons with right-aligned arrow; 1px hairline dividers; 2px inset focus ring in blue; crosshair cursor on canvas, underline on hover; sound: single 1kHz tick; photos none, data plots only; icons filled sharp; no texture; flush-left ragged-right type; 16-col grid

d2.medium: Compass-and-ruler geometry: every mark built from circles and their intersections, construction lines shown at 8% opacity
d2.motion: Slow ink reveal: stroke-dashoffset draws at 900ms cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1), then fill fades 400ms
d2.accents: Pill buttons with seal dot; double hairline rule dividers; vermilion ring focus with 4px offset; brush cursor on art; hover darkens indigo; sound: wooden clack; woodblock illustration, photos as washi-texture duotone; icons filled in mon roundels; washi fibre texture 4%; centered scroll axis, vertical rhythm 8px

d3.medium: Flat vector with repeating patterns: squiggle, terrazzo, zigzag fills as SVG pattern tiles
d3.motion: Bouncy squash and stretch: scaleY 0.9 / scaleX 1.1 on press, overshoot cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) 300ms
d3.accents: Chunky 16px-radius buttons with 4px bottom lip; dashed 2px dividers; thick 3px pink focus ring; pointer cursor with press squash; sound: pop; flat illustration, photos cut into blob masks; icons filled with lip; terrazzo texture in margins; stacked card layout

d4.medium: Photomontage collage: halftone photos cut into wedges and circles over flat red and black
d4.motion: Diagonal wipes at 30 degrees: clip-path polygon wipe 500ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1)
d4.accents: Rectangular buttons with clipped corner; 4px red diagonal dividers; red 3px focus ring offset diagonally; hover inverts; sound: press stamp; photos halftone duotone red/black; icons filled sharp with red wedge; newsprint grain texture; condensed uppercase type rotated -4 to -8 degrees; diagonal layout axis

d5.medium: Generative tiling code: girih and khatam patterns computed in JS/SVG from compass-and-straightedge rules
d5.motion: Tessellation growth: tiles appear outward from a seed in rings, 60ms stagger, decelerate cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1)
d5.accents: 4px-radius buttons framed by star corners; dividers are interlace bands; turquoise double focus ring; hover glows pattern; sound: soft chime; illustration only generated tiling, photos masked in arches; icons filled with 4-point star marker; glaze crackle texture 3%; symmetric 8-fold layout

d6.medium: Blender primitives: cubes, cones, spheres rendered as stills and GLB; 2D graphics use only circle, square, triangle
d6.motion: Mechanical easing: steps(4) for state, 120ms linear for dials, knob rotates in 22.5 degree detents
d6.accents: Pill keys with 2px black keyline and an orange knob; 2px black rules; orange keyline focus; hover depresses 2px; sound: click detent; renders of primitives only; icons primitive two-color; matte paper texture; mono uppercase labels; hardware panel 8px module layout

d7.medium: Euclidean construction in code: every figure is a numbered proposition built from labelled points, circles and lines, colored in Byrne's red, yellow and blue; headings set on a stoichedon letter grid
d7.motion: Proof steps: construction lines draw in sequence, 240ms each, cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), then the conclusion and QED fade in
d7.accents: 2px-radius Codex buttons with a terracotta fill; meander (Greek key) dividers; 2px blue focus ring with a key corner; pointer cursor, hover underlines in terracotta; sound: a single lyre pluck; red-figure silhouettes for figures, Byrne diagrams for ideas; icons filled on a 20px grid; parchment grain texture; polytonic Greek alongside English; numbered proposition layout with proof column
